name: Should I manage the rental property remodel myself or hire a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I manage the rental property remodel myself or hire a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most rental property remodels, especially those involving multiple trades or significant structural changes, hiring a general contractor is highly recommended. A general contractor manages the entire project, including hiring subcontractors, scheduling, material procurement, and ensuring adherence to building codes. This saves you time, reduces stress, and often prevents costly mistakes. Self-managing is feasible only for very minor cosmetic updates if you have the time and expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: For most remodels, hiring a general contractor is best; they manage the project, saving time and preventing errors. Self-management is only suitable for minor cosmetic updates.
